2438-3661-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
2438-3661-5006-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

339-677-4742-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3129-5254-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-5254-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

997-5254-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
997-5254-5902.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

4772-5254-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4772-5254-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

654-2577-6495-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
654-2577-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

738-4050-7707-7881.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nontoken creature.
738-4050-7707-7881.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hullcarver, adding {B}.
When Hullcarver dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a nontoken creature they control.
When a creature dies this way, Glissa triggers, returning Hullcarver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Hullcarver by paying {B}.
Repeat as able.
738-4050-7707-7881.notes: You can repeat this lock during each of your turns so long as an opponent controls a nontoken creature.

5524-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5524-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Destiny Spinner
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1563-2457-6968-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1987-3227-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-3227-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-3227-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1545-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

261-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-4053-5223-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-5223-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-5223-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-765-1437-1993--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-765-1437-1993--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

240-1251-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

2440-2703-7296.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-6972-7156.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

5170-5231-5933-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

277-2653-2893-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Nissa and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

436-3680-5220.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Stunt Double dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stunt Double from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Stunt Double onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

1874-2034-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1874-2034-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3470-5702-5954-6753.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3470-5702-5954-6753.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3470-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

413-856-2267-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-2267-4321.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1992-2438-5994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2438-5994.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

141-1883.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-1883.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Replication Technique
141-1883.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Replication Technique, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

914-1309-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1309-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Salvager of Secrets.
When Dockside Extortionist and Salvager of Secrets enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-1309-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

851-4050-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cats, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1308-4770-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
1308-4770-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
2438-4871-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
3129-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating four Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

43-4770.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {1}{W}.
43-4770.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Paradox Engine triggers, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2459-3184-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {R}.
When Rograkh dies, Yomiji triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-3548-4082-4763.notablePrerequisites: Watchers of the Dead has at least one Equipment attached.
2034-3548-4082-4763.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Watchers of the Dead, adding {C}{C}.
Watchers of the Dead dies, triggering Koll, returning Watchers of the Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Watchers of the Dead by paying {2}.
Watchers of the Dead enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba, attaching any Equipment you control to it.
Repeat.

286-479-4755.notablePrerequisites:
Emrakul has the greatest power among creatures you control.
You have no other cards in hand.
286-479-4755.description:
Cast Rishkar's Expertise by paying {4}{G}{G}, causing you to draw thirteen cards.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.

25-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Torsten, adding {C}{C}.
Torsten dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Torsten trigger, creating seven 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Torsten from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Torsten enters the battlefield, allowing you to search the top seven cards of your library and put any number of creature and/or land cards from them into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1496-1738.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-1496-1738.description:
Cast Serra Avatar by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Serra Avatar enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Serra Avatar's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1769-2201-4187-4816.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2201-4187-4816.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Infectious Host from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Infectious Host die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Infectious Host and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Infectious Host trigger, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.

1769-2151-2201-2899.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2151-2201-2899.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vindictive Lich and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vindictive Lich trigger, causing target opponent to lose five life.
Repeat from step 4.
